shared_elements: upright monolithic slab/boulder with low-relief carving covering the front face
rounded oval cartouche-like units with internal curvilinear detail
schematic face-like elements with eyes rendered as ovals
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, curvilinear relief built from rounded oval cartouches and concentric disc motifs on the front of a standing monolith, and both include schematic face-like units with large oval eyes, which gives a loose stylistic kinship. But what is depicted differs fundamentally: A is a framed rectangular grid of repeated abstract sign-blocks arranged in orderly rows and columns, while B is a single anthropomorphic body — head, shoulders, arms and a pectoral disc with a belt-like band — with no ordered sign field at all.
